_comment: Expansion 3 part F.7: the flavour of the rest of Appendix B (stat blocks in statblocks.beasts.json) and where they are met: the beasts in their biomes, the pseudodragon, sprites and the sphinx of wonder alone, a cult circle with its imp or quasit, slaad tadpoles in the wizards' towers. The octopus, giant seahorse and reef shark are met when fights go under water (Expansion 23); until then they are shapes for Polymorph only.

ape.name: ape
descriptions: A broad-shouldered ape knuckles out of the undergrowth, shrieking and baring yellowed teeth.
It hefts a stone in one long hand and watches you with small, knowing eyes.
Scarred hands, a flat angry brow, and no fear of anything that walks on two legs.

badger.name: badger
descriptions: A squat grey badger hisses from the mouth of its sett, face striped black and white.
Low, thick-furred and ill-tempered; it will not give ground to something ten times its size.
Fresh-turned earth and a rank musk mark its den.

constrictor_snake.name: constrictor snake
descriptions: A thick-bodied snake hangs from a bough, its coils shifting as slowly as sap.
Mottled scales, a flickering tongue, and a body as heavy as a man's thigh.
You hear nothing until the coil is already tightening.

crocodile.name: crocodile
descriptions: Two eyes and a ridged snout break the brown water, perfectly still.
A log-long lizard lies on the mud bank, jaws agape, a bird picking at its teeth.
The bank is churned and slick where something heavy drags itself out to wait.

elephant.name: elephant
descriptions: A grey mountain of wrinkled hide sways out of the trees, tusks yellow as old bone.
The ground shakes with each step, and the birds fall silent before it comes into view.
Its ears flare wide and it lowers its head; whatever it was eating, it will not share.

elk.name: elk
descriptions: A tall elk stands in the bracken, antlers branching like winter trees.
Its breath smokes in the cold; its hooves paw at the earth.
In rutting season even the gentlest herd animal will lower its head and charge.

giant_badger.name: giant badger
descriptions: A badger the size of a hound crouches over a half-dug hole, claws black with soil.
Heavy shoulders, a striped skull and a growl like gravel in a bucket.
Earth is thrown up in great clods about its warren.

giant_crab.name: giant crab
descriptions: A crab as broad as a cartwheel scuttles out of the surf, claws clicking.
Its shell is barnacled and pitted, and one claw is held high like a threat.
It sidles across the shingle with unsettling speed.

giant_goat.name: giant goat
descriptions: A shaggy goat as big as a pony stands on a ledge above you, horns curled like ram's.
Pale slotted eyes, a matted beard, and hooves that find purchase on bare rock.
It stamps once, and loose stones rattle down the slope.

giant_seahorse.name: giant seahorse
descriptions: A seahorse the size of a pony, armoured in pale ridges, drifting upright in the green water.
Its snout is a hard blunt ram, and it wants you out of its reeds.
It hangs in the current, curled tail anchored, watching with one round dark eye.

giant_weasel.name: giant weasel
descriptions: A weasel as long as a man's leg, boneless in the way it pours over a fallen log.
Its coat is the colour of dead leaves and its eyes are bright, wet and hungry.
It comes at you low and fast, and it has never learned to be afraid.

goat.name: goat
descriptions: A scruffy goat with a cold yellow eye and a curl of horn.
It lowers its head, stamps once, and thinks about you the way a goat thinks about everything.
Someone's livelihood, or no one's, gone wild on the hillside.

imp.name: imp
descriptions: A red, leathery thing no bigger than a cat, wings flickering, its barbed tail curled over its back.
It grins with too many small teeth and watches your every move, ready to vanish the moment you turn on it.
The air smells of struck flint and old smoke where it hovers.

lion.name: lion
descriptions: A tawny lion, ribs shifting under its hide, crouched in the dry grass with its tail twitching.
It does not roar to warn you; it roars so that you will freeze.
Where one lion hunts, the others are lying in wait on either side of you.

octopus.name: octopus
descriptions: A mottled octopus, its skin rippling the colour of the rocks it clings to.
Boneless arms feel along the stones, tasting you with a hundred small suckers.
It watches with a cold, clever eye and does not blink.

panther.name: panther
descriptions: A black shape on a bough, a pair of green lamps and no sound at all.
You do not see it move; you see where it was, and then it is on you.
It has been following you since the last bend in the track.

pseudodragon.name: pseudodragon
descriptions: A little dragon the size of a house cat, red-brown scales dull as old rust, tail coiled round a stolen trinket.
It hisses and flares its wings to look larger, its yellow eyes never leaving your hands.
A barbed tail-tip twitches like a scorpion's, and the beast guards its nest of shiny scraps fiercely.

quasit.name: quasit
descriptions: A knee-high horned horror with scaly green skin and claws wet with something that is not water.
It crouches in the dark, chittering, its long tail lashing, waiting for you to look the other way.
Its grin is wide and wrong, and where it has stood the shadows seem to curdle.

reef_shark.name: reef shark
descriptions: A grey shark no longer than a man, circling in the shallows with its fin cutting the surface.
It swims in slow rings, coming a little closer on each pass.
The water is still clear, and the teeth in it are very clear indeed.

slaad_tadpole.name: slaad tadpole
descriptions: A slick, toad-bodied grub the size of a fist, all mouth and hunger, its skin shifting between sick colours.
It scuttles and burrows in the dirt, snapping at anything warm.
Where it came from, there will be more, and a worse thing growing in somebody's belly.

sphinx_of_wonder.name: sphinx of wonder
descriptions: A winged cat no bigger than a lion cub, its bright feathers marked with a strange sigil upon the brow.
It tilts its head and studies you like a page it has not yet read, curious more than wary.
It will talk and weigh your worth before it ever bares a claw, but it guards its learning well.

sprite.name: sprite
descriptions: A foot-tall figure with gossamer wings and leaf-stitched clothes, a bow no longer than your hand drawn taut.
It hangs in the branches, wary and watching, sizing you up for friend or trespasser.
If you mean the wood no harm it may simply let you pass, and if you do you will not see the arrows coming.

tiger.name: tiger
descriptions: Stripes of orange and black among the reeds, so still that you take it for shadow.
A great striped cat, shoulders rolling, each paw as wide as a man's hand.
The jungle goes quiet around it, and that is how you know it is near.

venomous_snake.name: venomous snake
descriptions: A thin patterned snake lying across the path, its tongue tasting the air.
It coils in the sun-warmed stones, and you almost step on it before you see.
Small, quick and quiet; the sting of its bite is out of all proportion to its size.

apes.name: a troop of apes
intro: Branches thrash overhead, and the apes come down out of them shrieking.
A great grey-black ape stands in the path, beating the ground, and the trees behind it fill with others.
Fruit rinds on the ground, then a stone flung from the leaves: the troop has seen you.

badger.name: a badger
intro: You have stepped too near a sett. Its owner bustles out, hissing like a kettle.
A striped face in the bracken, and a growl far bigger than the beast behind it.
A badger backs out of its hole and turns on you with every ounce of a bad temper.

giant_badgers.name: giant badgers
intro: The earth heaves beside the path and a badger the size of a hound claws its way out.
Something big is digging in the dark. It stops, and you hear it sniff.
Two striped heads rise from a fresh-turned mound, black eyes on you.

constrictor_snake.name: a constrictor snake
intro: What you took for a root lifts its head and slides towards you.
A heavy coil drops from the branch above, muscle the thickness of a man's thigh.
The reeds part slowly. Something long and patterned is coming through them.

crocodiles.name: crocodiles
intro: The log at the water's edge opens its jaws.
Ripples, and then nothing, and then the water bursts at your feet.
A crocodile hauls itself up the bank, slow and certain, as if it has done this before.

elephants.name: elephants
intro: Ears flare like sails and a trumpet splits the air: you are too close to the herd.
The ground shakes before you see them. A bull elephant lowers its tusks.
Grey shapes among the thorn trees turn as one, and the biggest comes for you.

elk.name: elk
intro: A bull elk paws the ground and swings its antlers low. It is the rut, and you are in the way.
Elk crash out of the trees, and the stag at their head does not turn aside.
A bellow, a stamp, and a rack of antlers like a thorn hedge coming at you.

giant_crabs.name: giant crabs
intro: The rocks on the tideline get up and walk sideways towards you.
Claws clack in the surf. Crabs as broad as cartwheels, and hungry.
The sand heaves and a shell the size of a shield shakes itself free.

goats.name: wild goats
intro: A flock of wild goats blocks the track, and the billy at its head lowers his horns.
Hooves clatter on the scree above. The goats have decided you do not belong here.
A shaggy billy goat stares at you, chewing, then charges without a sound.

giant_goats.name: giant goats
intro: Goats as big as ponies leap down the cliff, and the leader comes at you horns first.
A crack like an axe on oak echoes off the rocks: two giant goats butting. Then they see you.
On the ledge ahead, great curled horns turn towards you, and a hoof stamps once.

giant_weasels.name: giant weasels
intro: Long russet shapes pour over a fallen trunk and spread out around you.
Something chitters in the dark, and then there are eyes on every side.
A weasel as long as a man rises on its hind legs, sniffs, and calls the others.

lions.name: a pride of lions
intro: The long grass moves against the wind. Lions, low and spread out, closing.
A roar rolls over the plain, so close you feel it in your teeth.
Tawny backs in the grass on either side: the pride has made you its hunt.

panther.name: a panther
intro: Two green eyes in the branches above, and then the branch is empty.
The night birds stop. A black shape drops from the dark onto the path.
You smell it before you see it: musk, and fresh blood on its breath.

tiger.name: a tiger
intro: Orange and black stripes uncoil from the reeds, and a tiger walks out into the open.
A low cough behind you. You turn, and the tiger is already running.
The deer trail is fresh with blood. At its end the tiger lifts its head from its kill.

venomous_snakes.name: venomous snakes
intro: A dry rattle under the stones, and a flat head rises to strike.
You have stepped on a nest. Thin patterned bodies whip out of the grass.
A snake lies coiled in the sun across the path, and it does not mean to move.

pseudodragon.name: a pseudodragon
intro: A little dragon no bigger than a cat sits on its heap of shiny pebbles and hisses at you.
Rust-red wings flash out of a crevice: you have walked into something's tiny hoard.
A small dragon lands on a rock, tail lashing, and looks at you as a cat looks at a mouse.

sprites.name: sprites
intro: Tiny arrows whisper past your ear, and laughter like bells comes from nowhere.
Gossamer wings flicker between the leaves: foot-tall archers, bows drawn, watching you.
A voice no bigger than a bee's tells you to turn back. Several bows creak at once.

sphinx_of_wonder.name: a sphinx of wonder
intro: A winged cat with feathers like a sunset lands on a stone and asks you nothing, yet.
Something bright circles overhead, then settles before you: a sphinx no bigger than a lion cub.
A sigil glows on the forehead of the small winged creature that blocks the path.

cult_circle_imp.name: a cult circle and its devil
intro: Chanting in a ring of candles, and on the preacher's shoulder something red and winged grins at you.
The preacher whispers to the little devil at his ear, and it laughs and points at you.
A barbed tail flicks in the candlelight above the circle. The cult has a servant from below.

cult_circle_quasit.name: a cult circle and its demon
intro: A small green horror squats in the middle of the chanting ring, licking its claws.
The candles gutter green. Something with horns crouches at the preacher's feet.
The cult's demon, no taller than a child's knee, hisses and vanishes as you look at it.

slaad_tadpoles.name: slaad tadpoles
intro: Broken jars on the floor, and the things that were in them are hungry.
Wet, toad-like grubs pour out of a cracked vat, mouths open, colours crawling on their skins.
Something the wizard bred here has bred again. The floor is moving.
